builds.name: Reference: Ranked jungle core
builds.goal: Reference for Naafiri: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ jungle players use most (5,578 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55.4% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A pack-assisted AD skirmisher who lands paired daggers, preserves packmates with repositioning, and pursues a takedown reset. Her current R is the pursuit dash, while W grants untargetability and pack reinforcement. The current jungle provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Voltaic Cyclosword → Black Cleaver → Death's Dance. Conqueror keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Ionian Boots of Lucidity, Guardian Angel, Serpent's Fang.
builds.summary: The proven jungle baseline: Voltaic Cyclosword → Black Cleaver → Death's Dance, with Conqueror.
testPlan: Play it in jungle as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Voltaic Cyclosword → Black Cleaver → Death's Dance) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55.4% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Voltaic Cyclosword → Black Cleaver → Death's Dance.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Naafiri creates a Packmate every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds that will Attack enemies that she targets for [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 20; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, increased to [(characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 20; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (1.3)] after she uses an Ability. 

Hitting champions and large monsters with Abilities reduces this Ability's Cooldown by [4] seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by [1] seconds.

Max Packmates: [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])]

Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalDamageFirstCast@ physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalBleedDamage@ physical damage over @spell.NaafiriQ:BleedDuration@ seconds.

Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMinDamageSecondCast@ and @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalMaxDamageSecondCast@ physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores @spell.NaafiriQ:TotalHealSecondCast@ Health.

Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for @spell.NaafiriP:PackmateTauntDuration@ seconds.

Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing [125 / 200 / 275 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing [(125 / 200 / 275 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.1)] physical damage per Packmate.

If Naafiri scores a Takedown within [7] seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants [100 / 150 / 200 + (1.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [3] seconds.

Naafiri becomes Untargetable for [1] second and prepares to hunt, spawning [2] additional Packmates and gaining [(0.2) × AD] Attack Damage and [(0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed for [5] seconds.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri.

Naafiri surges forward, dealing [15 / 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health.

builds.name: Pack health spell fighter
builds.summary: Test pack health spell fighter against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test pack health spell fighter against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: The Call of the Pack grants 20% total AD for five seconds; Bloodmail's purchased-health AD feeds physical Q/E/R damage during that window. Shojin favors repeated spells and Sundered Sky rewards Naafiri's own attack after E; Visage supports Q healing and the conditional second-R shield.
testPlan: Required state: Keep packmates alive and earn the R recast through a takedown.
Compare two Q casts and E with pack count held constant.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Delayed damage loses the seven-second takedown window.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Packmates do not automatically inherit Sundered Sky or Naafiri's item attack effects.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Spear of Shojin, Black Cleaver, Sundered Sky, Spirit Visage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Naafiri: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A pack-assisted AD skirmisher who lands paired daggers, preserves packmates with repositioning, and pursues a takedown reset. Her current R is the pursuit dash, while W grants untargetability and pack reinforcement. Track packmate availability and actual leap/bleed sequence. Do not award every pet hit as a full independent item proc; health-heavy routes need repeated contact to repay lost pick damage. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Naafiri: Track packmate availability and actual leap/bleed sequence. Do not award every pet hit as a full independent item proc; health-heavy routes need repeated contact to repay lost pick damage.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.

The route fails Naafiri's stated kit question: Track packmate availability and actual leap/bleed sequence. Do not award every pet hit as a full independent item proc; health-heavy routes need repeated contact to repay lost pick damage.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.

Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.
